purpose: preview-only: choose visual direction before game integration

prompts.A: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: preview-only sprite concept board for a cozy fantasy farming RPG. Reference image is the existing interior atlas at the supplied path; match its orthographic top-down three-quarter view (see tabletop and fronts), warm wood, dark clear contour, soft hand-painted pixel-friendly shading, readable at about 160x120 game pixels. Create a wide transparent-background board containing EXACTLY THREE separate study desks arranged horizontally with generous empty gutters, equal scale, same ground pivot, matching footprint. Left is level 1, center level 2, right level 3. Each upgrade visibly adds capability while retaining the base desk silhouette. No scene, floor, people, written labels, letters, numerals, border, watermark. Small grounded contact shadows stay inside each sprite, no environmental cast shadows. Do not copy reference props literally. Direction A: rural scholar's workshop. Level 1 modest sturdy oak desk with open notebook, quill, candle, simple sample tray and hand magnifier. Level 2 reinforced oak desk with copper magnifying arm, balance scales, labelled-looking but textless sample drawers, two glass specimen vessels. Level 3 refined oak desk with brass optical lens assembly, small blue moon crystal held by clamps, organized reagent rack and drawers. Practical compact medieval craftsmanship; moon glow very subtle, no giant magical machinery.
